description: This file defines interfaces for managing the lifecycle of grains in Orleans, including migration, dehydration, and rehydration contexts.

classes.name: IGrainLifecycle
classes.description: Represents an observable lifecycle of a grain, allowing registration and removal of migration participants.

classes.name: IGrainMigrationParticipant
classes.description: Defines methods for handling dehydration and rehydration during grain migration.

classes.name: IDehydrationContext
classes.description: Represents the state during dehydration of a grain activation for migration, allowing adding data by key.

classes.name: IRehydrationContext
classes.description: Represents the state during rehydration of a grain after migration, allowing retrieval of data by key.

methods.name: AddMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Registers a migration participant to the grain lifecycle.

methods.name: RemoveMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Unregisters a migration participant from the grain lifecycle.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Invoked to allow a participant to handle dehydration, providing access to the dehydration context.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Invoked to allow a participant to handle rehydration, providing access to the rehydration context.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Gets the collection of keys stored in the dehydration or rehydration context.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds a byte sequence to the dehydration context associated with a specified key.

methods.name: AddBytes<T>
methods.description: Adds a value to the dehydration context by serializing it using a delegate.

methods.name: TryAddValue
methods.description: Attempts to add a value to the dehydration context, serializing it if possible.

methods.name: TryGetBytes
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a byte sequence from the rehydration context by key.

methods.name: TryGetValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and deserialize a value from the rehydration context by key.
